inlines.v: TIRA'DE, noun 1. Formerly in French music, the filling of an interval by the intermediate diatonic notes. 2. In modern usage, a strain or flight; a series of violent declamation. Here he delivers a violent tirade against all persons who profess to know any thing about angels.
